summary: TFI International filed a Form 6-K announcing TSX approval of a renewed normal course issuer bid (NCIB), the Canadian equivalent of a US share repurchase program. The company may buy back up to 7,628,841 common shares, 10% of the 76,288,419-share public float as of October 30, 2026, over November 10, 2026 to November 9, 2027. Purchases occur at market price via TSX, NYSE and alternative systems; 81,800,978 shares were outstanding. The Board endorses buybacks as a use of capital; RBC Dominion Securities administers an automatic share purchase plan for blackout periods. Watch actual repurchase pace versus the prior 688,137 shares bought and CAD 152.1286 average price.
